apps.name: Kyro
apps.subtitle: Self-hosted media streaming client
apps.localizedDescription: Kyro is a customized iOS streaming client based on Silo, bringing your self-hosted media library together with an enhanced IPTV experience and Sports Hub features. Enjoy movies, TV shows, live channels, a personalized interface, and more in one app. Built for users who want greater control over their streaming experience. Sports Hub features are in development.
